But FitzGerald's friends (to whom most of the letters hitherto published were addressed) were cultured gentlemen, men of the first rank of the time, of the first rank of all time, men who would necessarily be swayed by the charm of his culture, by the delicacy of his wit, by the refinement of his thoughts.

arxiv-2203-04597.title: On the rigidity of the Sasakian structure and characterization of cosymplectic manifolds
arxiv-2203-04597.creator: Dhriti Sundar Patra, Vladimir Rovenski
arxiv-2203-04597.description: Abstract We introduce new metric structures on a smooth manifold (called “weak” structures) that generalize the almost contact, Sasakian, cosymplectic, etc. metric structures ( φ , ξ , η , g ) (\varphi,\xi,\eta,g) and allow us to take a fresh look at the classical theory. We demonstrate this statement by generalizing several well-known results.

arxiv-2210-13997.title: The LHCspin project
arxiv-2210-13997.creator: \firstname Marco \lastname Santimaria \fnsep, \firstname Vittore \lastname Carassiti, \firstname Giuseppe \lastname Ciullo, \firstname Pasquale \lastname Di Nezza, \firstname Paolo \lastname Lenisa, \firstname Saverio \lastname Mariani, \firstname Luciano Libero \lastname Pappalardo, \firstname Erha
arxiv-2210-13997.description: Abstract The goal of LHCspin is to develop, in the next few years, innovative solutions and cutting-edge technologies to access spin physics in polarised fixed-target collisions at high energy, exploring the unique kinematic regime offered by LHC and exploiting new final states by means of the LHCb detector.

arxiv-2502-18734.title: Beyond RNNs: Benchmarking Attention-Based Image Captioning Models
arxiv-2502-18734.creator: Hemanth Teja Yanambakkam, Rahul Chinthala
arxiv-2502-18734.description: Abstract 1 Problem Statement Image captioning is the automatic generation of textual descriptions for images, a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence at the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. This task involves identifying key objects, their attributes, and their relationships within an image while generating syntactically and semantically coherent sentences that accurately describe the scene.

arxiv-2504-19313.title: On dominant ℓ \ell –weights and maps between Weyl modules for quantum affine A n A_{n} Thanks: M.B. was partially supported CNPq grant 405793/2023-5 Thanks: V.C. was partially supported by a travel grant from the Simons Foundation.
arxiv-2504-19313.creator: Matheus Brito, Vyjayanthi Chari
arxiv-2504-19313.description: Abstract . We determine the set of dominant ℓ \ell –weights in the Weyl (or standard) modules for quantum affine A n A_{n} . We then prove that the space of homomorphisms between standard modules is at most one-dimensional and give a necessary and sufficient condition for equality to hold.

arxiv-2508-10871.title: On a nonnegativity conjecture of Andrews
arxiv-2508-10871.creator: Yazan Alamoudi
arxiv-2508-10871.description: Abstract . I settle a conjecture of Andrews related to the Alladi-Schur polynomials. In addition, I give further relations and implications to two families of polynomials related to the Alladi-Schur polynomials. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification 11P81, 11P83, 05A17 1. Introduction The conjecture in question relates to polynomials arising in an investigation of integer partitions.

arxiv-2509-25052.title: Cogito, Ergo Ludo: An Agent that Learns to Play by Reasoning and Planning
arxiv-2509-25052.creator: Sai Wang, Yu Wu, Zhongwen Xu
arxiv-2509-25052.description: Abstract Abstract: The pursuit of artificial agents that can learn to master complex environments has led to remarkable successes, yet prevailing deep reinforcement learning methods often rely on immense experience, encoding their knowledge opaquely within neural network weights. We propose a different paradigm, one in which an agent learns to play by reasoning and planning.

pmc-10545769.title: Mechanistic insight on water dissociation on pristine low-index TiO2 surfaces from machine learning molecular dynamics simulations
pmc-10545769.creator: Zezhu Zeng, Felix Wodaczek, Keyang Liu, Frederick Stein, Jürg Hutter, Ji Chen, Bingqing Cheng
pmc-10545769.description: Water adsorption and dissociation processes on pristine low-index TiO2 interfaces are important but poorly understood outside the well-studied anatase (101) and rutile (110). To understand these, we construct three sets of machine learning potentials that are simultaneously applicable to various TiO2 surfaces, based on three density-functional-theory approximations.

pmc-10575362.title: Mechanically Tough and Highly Stretchable Hydrogels Based on Polyurethane for Sensitive Strain Sensor
pmc-10575362.creator: Jianyang Shi, Shuang Wang, Haibo Wang, Jun Gu
pmc-10575362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Hydrogels with flexible and stretchable properties are ideal for applications in wearable sensors. However, traditional hydrogel-based sensors suffer from high brittleness and low electrical sensitivity. In this case, to solve this dilemma, a macromolecular polyurethane crosslinking agent (PCA) was designed and prepared; after that, PCA and two-dimensional (2D) MXene nanosheets were both introduced into a covalently crosslinked network to enhance the comprehensive mechanical and electrochemical properties of the hydrogels.

pmc-10738464.title: THE IMPACT OF WORKPLACE DEMANDS AND RESOURCES ON THE JOB SATISFACTION OF MINORITY AND IMMIGRANT CNAS
pmc-10738464.creator: Frances Hawes, Shuangshuang Wang
pmc-10738464.description: This study examines the association between occupational stress (job resources and demands) and job satisfaction among nursing assistants (NAs) in the long-term care (LTC) sector, considering differences based on race/ethnicity and immigration status. Data from 2,763 NAs were retrieved from the National Nursing Assistant Survey (NNAS).

pmc-11352678.title: Relations between Neurocognitive Function and Visual Acuity: A Cross-Sessional Study in a Cohort of Premature Children
pmc-11352678.creator: Chun-Hsien Tu, Wei-Chi Wu, Wei-Chih Chin, Shih-Chieh Hsu, I Tang, Jen-Fu Hsu, Hung-Da Chou, Eugene Yu-Chuan Kang, Yu-Shu Huang
pmc-11352678.description: Background: Premature children with retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) have been reported to an have increased risk of visual and neurocognitive impairments, yet little is known about whether vision could affect specific neurocognition. This study aimed to clarify the correlations between neurocognition and vision in premature children.

pmc-11415393.title: Discharge Outcomes of Hospitalized Patients with New Onset Decompensated Cirrhosis
pmc-11415393.creator: Abraham Ifrah, Rachel Fromer, Alec Harrison Gayner, Ho-Man Yeung
pmc-11415393.description: IntroductionThere are a lack of data describing outcomes and follow-up after hospital discharge for patients with newly diagnosed cirrhosis with complication on index admission. This study examines factors that influence outcomes such as readmission, follow-up, and mortality for patients with newly diagnosed cirrhosis.

pmc-11510032.title: Lactose Breath Test: Possible Strategies to Optimize Test Performance, Accuracy, and Clinical Impact
pmc-11510032.creator: Giulia Scalese, Alessandra Cesarini, Lucia Pallotta, Emanuela Ribichini, Luca Spina, Maddalena Diofebi, Anna Citarella, Simona Cammarota, Carola Severi
pmc-11510032.description: Lactose malabsorption (LM) refers to the incomplete absorption of lactose in the small intestine, resulting in the arrival of ingested lactose in the colon, which can give rise to symptoms defined as lactose intolerance (LI). The lactose breath test (LBT), thanks to its low cost, availability, and noninvasiveness, is the most used diagnostic method.

pmc-11692981.title: THE SALUTOGENIC EFFICACY OF THE VOICE-ACTIVATED INTELLIGENT PERSONAL ASSISTANT INTERVENTION: A CASE STUDY
pmc-11692981.creator: Terence Lau, Angela Leung
pmc-11692981.description: Existing Parkinson’s disease (PD) interventions are primarily focused on physical rehabilitation and pathogenic-based. The lack of positive, health-orientated psychosocial interventions prompted the research team to develop a salutogenic VIPA user protocol and examine its preliminary efficacy through an 8-week pilot RCT.

pmc-12448125.title: A unified account of current-future control and affordance-based control for running to catch fly balls
pmc-12448125.creator: Dees B. W. Postma, Frank T. J. M. Zaal
pmc-12448125.description: Current-future control and affordance-based control offer two distinct approaches to understanding the visual guidance of action. Current-future control strategies, such as the optical acceleration cancellation strategy, are essentially error-nulling strategies. That is, the visual guidance of action is predicated on nulling the error around the critical value of some optical invariant.

pmc-12660136.title: Consensus-based qubit configuration optimization for variational algorithms on neutral atom quantum systems
pmc-12660136.creator: Robert J. P. T. de Keijzer, Luke Y. Visser, Oliver Tse, Servaas J. J. M. F. Kokkelmans
pmc-12660136.description: We report an algorithm that is able to tailor qubit interactions for individual variational quantum algorithm problems. The algorithm leverages the unique ability of a neutral atom tweezer platform to realize arbitrary qubit position configurations. These configurations determine the degree of entanglement available to a variational quantum algorithm via the interatomic interactions.

pmc-12706030.title: Ceftazidime prescription and antibiotic resistance patterns in a tertiary care hospital
pmc-12706030.creator: Banan M Aiesh, Shama Amoudi, Leena Bassalat, Abeer Yousef, Dania Abuhalima, Adham Abutaha, Samah W Al-Jabi, Ali Sabateen, Sa’ed H Zyoud
pmc-12706030.description: Ceftazidime, a third-generation cephalosporin, is effective for treating infections caused by gram-negative bacteria. However, increasing antibiotic resistance, particularly in multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacilli, complicates treatment decisions and patient outcomes. This study aimed to assess the clinical epidemiology and characteristics of patients treated with intravenous ceftazidime and clarify the drug resistance patterns of the isolated pathogens.

pmc-12736428.title: Intrathecal Drug Delivery Systems for Chronic Pain Management: A Narrative Review of Pharmacologic Agents, Clinical Applications, and Considerations
pmc-12736428.creator: Milan Patel, Alison J. Deng, Madelyn Reilly, Mariam Morcus, Alyssa McKenzie, Lukas Henjum, Alan D. Kaye, Alaa Abd-Elsayed
pmc-12736428.description: This narrative review seeks to delve into the different on and off-label medications commonly used with intrathecal drug delivery systems (IDDS) and their clinical applications specifically in pain management settings. This review utilizes a variety of studies including reviews, retrospective chart analyses, and more to analyze the current effectiveness of various pharmacological agents on reducing chronic pain through IDDS.
